purpose: Separate project-authorized source-to-WordPress adaptations from unresolved parity defects so a future exactness pass does not undo correct implementation decisions.

authorized_divergences.target: canonical WordPress /slug/ destinations while anchors are preserved
authorized_divergences.closeout_rule: Do not rewrite target links back to .html merely for literal URL equality.

authorized_divergences.area: Form submission model and success body
authorized_divergences.source: Frozen demo form has empty endpoint and states that no message was sent.
authorized_divergences.target: MetForm stores local entries with external notifications/webhooks disabled; success title/contact guidance are source-equivalent but the body truthfully states local request recording instead of falsely claiming a demo no-send state.
authorized_divergences.closeout_rule: Do not copy the source demo-only no-send wording verbatim onto a target that actually records local entries. No SMTP or external submission is part of current acceptance.
Parity is judged by output/behavior/semantics under the accepted decisions, not by recreating the source implementation technology byte-for-byte.

unresolved_not_yet_authorized_as_diverge.rule: Do not silently call this a PASS or silently roll it back. Fresh source/target AX and owner proof are required; if intentionally retained, document the accessibility rationale explicitly before final closeout.

not_a_divergence_but_tooling_gap: formal six-viewport pixel equality cannot be claimed without synchronized screenshot/overlay/diff tooling
hero/gallery/form outer source region semantics remain unimplemented until complete target roots are proven
required service-radio live configuration/behavior remains unread, not intentionally divergent
global_out_of_scope_note: Reference footer-credit/global template differences are not to be modified from the page272-only package. They must be judged in the separate global-template scope, not hidden inside a Hedge page write.
